Fig. 15 shows the alitrunk conspicuously swollen, sitting well above the propodeal dorsum. The propodeum carries a pair of strong spines, straight to slightly upcurved. There is no metanotal groove; the metapleural lobes are triangular and conspicuous. In profile the petiole has an elongate peduncle and a well-developed node whose dorsum slopes down posteriorly, leaving a short posterior face. The head dorsum is strongly longitudinally rugose, with 5–7 rugae between the frontal carinae at eye level. These rugae are irregular and meander slightly, usually with a few anastomoses. The scrobal area is mostly smooth, though 1–2 fine rugulae usually cross its width just behind the antennal fossa. Behind the eyes the sides of the head are finely reticulate-rugose, and this sculpture runs around the posterior margins of the scrobe to the occiput. The spaces between the rugae are unsculptured, or at most carry faint superficial traces.

The dorsal alitrunk is finely but strongly reticulate-rugose throughout, with broad shining interspaces. The petiole dorsum is rugulose; the postpetiole ranges from rugulose to only faintly sculptured. The gaster is unsculptured. Fine, acute hairs densely clothe all dorsal surfaces of the head and body. Color runs from dark reddish brown to blackish brown.

UPO-06 carries the coding sequence for *Ralstonia solanacearum* prhI. This ECF sigma factor is what the Prh signal transduction system needs to drive transcription. PrhR switches the gene on, and the sigma factor then acts through the PprhJ promoter. We codon-optimized the sequence so it expresses in *Escherichia coli*.

UPO-11: PprhJ promoter synthesis
UPO-11 gives you the PprhJ promoter region. When the bacterium touches plant cells, PrhA and PrhR pass the signal down, and PrhI activates the promoter. Like UPO-06, the sequence is optimized for expression in *Escherichia coli*.

Subject: foxl2 expression in trout: what we found

Dear Customer,

A quick summary of what we saw with foxl2 transcript expression in your study.

Both transcripts show up very early in development (Figure 2). foxl2a is highly restricted in the male. foxl2b, the diverged paralog, is present in most adult extragonadal tissues we examined (see Additional file 2).

Females look different. foxl2b expression there is largely confined to skin, gill, and ovary. In the testis, foxl2b expression is very strong. That matches earlier work showing foxl2b present and foxl2a absent in later stages of testis development in trout [23].

Taken together, these results point to foxl2b as a possible regulator of male-specific genes (such as cyp19b1), particularly later in development.

We derived a time-dependent mild-slope equation, following the formal derivation of Smith & Sprinks (1975). From it we got a higher-order dispersion relation for waves over an uneven bottom.

Using only the linear dispersion for steady waves, we recovered equation (2.12) of Chamberlain & Porter (1995), the Modified Mild-Slope Equation (MMSE). At leading order, the modified curvature terms of the MMSE matter; the slope-square terms stay negligible, as the mild-slope assumption predicts. So we kept the modified curvature terms the MSE drops. That gives us a uniform model.

We built a numerical model with the finite element method (FEM) to predict wave scattering over a varying bottom. The uniform model captures the main features of waves over different sea beds, sinusoidal beds and man-made bars included. On sinusoidal beds it tracks the experimental data more closely than the other established models. On man-made bars, both the MMSE and the uniform model do better than Kirby (1986).

Where the FEM model earns its keep is wave transformation over arbitrarily varying bathymetry.

Some countries sell tablets that combine aspirin, paracetamol (acetaminophen), or ibuprofen with codeine over the counter. Others want a prescription first.

You may have heard of cold water extraction of codeine. Recreational users like it because it speeds up absorption and cuts the liver damage paracetamol causes, along with the stomach irritation from aspirin and ibuprofen. Here's the catch: if you don't measure the insoluble product you remove, running many low-dose tablets through a sloppy extraction can hurt your liver anyway. So follow the safety guidelines on dosage and extraction, every time.

The same method also pulls hydrocodone and oxycodone out of similar compounds. Those are usually prescription-only.

Feb 12, 1542. That's when Francisco de Orellana finally reached the Amazon River, after a journey that began deep in the Sierra.

People assume it all happened at once. It didn't. Colonization started decades earlier, but Iquitos wasn't founded until the 1750s. Look at where it sits: between the Nanay River and the left bank of the Amazon. There's a reason it became the jumping-off point for exploring the whole region.

The Jesuits and Franciscans did much of the early work during the colonial era. They evangelized the region, founded towns, and opened the first travel routes, which cut the distances between indigenous groups and colonial villages.

I've studied the Amazon's history for years, and I still come back to this: those early explorations shaped everything that came after.

Tooth decay is the most common disease of childhood, and most of it goes untreated. Left alone, it damages far more than teeth: general health, physical development, social life, learning. And like most health problems, it hits low socio-economic populations hardest.

The diet link is worth your attention. The same habits that drive childhood obesity drive caries: frequent refined carbohydrates (mostly sugars), soft drinks and other sweetened beverages, and too little fluoridated water. Since obesity rates are at concerning levels in most countries, one intervention could target both conditions. Both are largely preventable, and the solutions can be sustainable and equitable.

That is what this study sets out to test: how children's drink choices affect their obesity risk and their oral health, followed prospectively over time.
